chunks: My father (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Isma'il ibn Muslim, from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from his grandfather, from al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon them both). He said:

I heard my grandfather the Messenger of God (may God's blessings be upon him and his family) say to me: Perform the obligations of God, and you will be the most Godfearing of people. Be content with the portion of God, and you will be the richest of people. Abstain from the forbidden things of God, and you will be the most pious of people. Beautify your neighbourliness to your neighbours, and you will be a believer. Beautify your companionship with your companions, and you will be a Muslim.
ai.seo_question: What five commandments did the Prophet Muhammad give to Imam Husayn?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (s) gave Imam al-Husayn five comprehensive commandments covering the full spectrum of Islamic life: fulfill God's obligations for Godfearingness, be content with His provision for true wealth, abstain from His prohibitions for piety, be a good neighbour for faith, and be a good companion for Islam.
